text: そんな　たたかいかたも　あるのね！

structure.jp: そんな　たたかいかたも
structure.en: a way of fighting like that too

patterns.name: 〜かた
patterns.explanation: かた after the stem of a verb means 'way of doing'. たたかいかた = 'way of fighting'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の plus ね is a soft, feminine way of saying you just realized something. あるのね = 'oh, there is'.
